chapter: Lee Collins and the riverboat Washington
title: Meeting Louis Jordan, Jimmy Pryor's band and Harry James's father
summary: On the road they met Joe Robichaux, Louis Jordan and the minstrel shows.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Yeah, one time the level was broke, we was going up there. We'd make a laugh, got up there around, got up there around, September was our last excursion, and Tillman Wilbert went up there with a big old white suit on and it snowed. He said, I love that pair of pants. I said, well what? I said, you ought to borrow clothes up there. He ended up snowing. White suit. Caught him with a summer suit out there. You see, the artists will remind you of Melton, Tennessee. You know you walk one block you can't see, you know it's hilly, you know. All that red clay and all that stuff. Oh yeah, we used to give an excursion. We went out there one time and we met Mac and Mac Show on the road and we met Joe Robichaud. He was with this guy out from here, trumpet player out there from Alvin Alcon. They was playing with, oh, from Port Arthur, what's his name? Oh I can't, we met them.

Don Alvin, yeah, we met them out there and then we met Louis Jordan. He was with the Rabbit Foot Minister and we met Jimmy Pryor's orchestra. You understand? Jimmy Pryor? Yeah, from Alvarado, his piano player. You understand what I mean? And Louis Jordan was with him. You understand? And them guys had that wood alcohol, talking about, that old sterno, you know what he was talking about, you know what he was talking about, blowing the poison off it and all that kind of stuff. And we met them out there. And then the people right there, Alvin and them, down Alvin, they had them like the little small chairs, be on St. Charles Street, the trees, the people where they were, give them a party for them. But we got off there with the real stuff that we had got in this baseball game. You know what I told you about, that Blue Lake Mule, talking about the ball, we had a carnival out there. Yeah you see, Louis Jordan used to be with the minister, the minister show before he got to be, what's he called, you know, this bad trumpet player, this white boy, he used to be with the minister too, or his daddy, he used to be with the carnival. Harry James. Yeah. Harry James. Yeah.
